poses.caption: Lie supine with knees bent, feet flat and arms at sides.
Tilt the pelvis and slowly peel the lower spine off the mat.
Lift into a bridge, pause, then roll the spine down slowly.

jobs.detail: ROLLING BRIDGE, THREE phases of ONE slow repetition. Full-body SIDE VIEW, HEAD LEFT FEET RIGHT in every panel. Lie supine face UP on plain thin gray floor mat. Back of skull rests DIRECTLY ON MAT in ALL phases, eyes ceiling, neck relaxed neutral, no head lifting or neck bridging. Arms straight at sides palms down, knees bent and both feet flat hip width, heels under knees at top, feet NEVER move. LEFT START: pelvis and full back on mat, knees bent. CENTER PARTIAL ROLL: posterior pelvic tilt, tailbone/pelvis and lower lumbar lift just slightly while upper and middle back and head stay grounded. RIGHT TOP: pelvis rises to gentle bridge with shoulders/hips/knees aligned, upper shoulder blades and skull stay grounded; no excessive lumbar arch. Both arms stay mat at sides, both shoes planted in every phase. Display clearly progressive low/mid/high pelvic elevation. No equipment except thin mat. Fine grayscale exposed arm/calf anatomy, red only soft blurred abdominal fabric tint, opaque shirt continuous to waistband no abdomen exposed.

Full opaque shirt/shorts front sides back seat crotch. No text.
